recommendation_en: Mother’s own milk is recommended for feeding of preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants. (Strong recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 建议为早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，喂养母乳。（强烈推荐，低确定性证据）
